subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw expose blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content to a new pre-admission hook and auto-enable trusted access-request handlers for existing allowlist configurations, and if accepted, must sender classification use the canonical access-group contract?
rationale: This establishes a permanent plugin API, privacy boundary, activation default, and persisted configuration model; implementation correctness cannot determine those product and security policies.

options.title: Align And Split
options.body: Require canonical access groups, keep activation explicit until approved, and separate the hook API from unrelated automation churn.

options.title: Accept Current Boundary
options.body: Approve raw pre-auth content exposure, trusted auto-loading, and the parallel grouped allowlist configuration as deliberate supported contracts.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Park or close the PR if maintainers do not want to sponsor a core pre-auth observation and access-classification surface.

recommendation.title: Align And Split
recommendation.body: Require canonical access groups, keep activation explicit until approved, and separate the hook API from unrelated automation churn.

likelyOwner.reason: The security team owns the affected shared security paths and is the strongest available owner for the pre-admission confidentiality decision.
